title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Snyk
providers.scope_notes: Snyk SaaS; API access, service accounts and audit logs require the Enterprise plan, while Free/Team personal tokens work only for CLI/IDE/CI.

controls.name: Snyk App scopes
controls.what: App permissions are fixed Org-level scopes, and an installer cannot grant scopes beyond their own permissions.

controls.name: Revoke authorized Snyk App
controls.what: User revokes an app from Authorized Snyk Apps; admins can delete Group/Org installs by API.
controls.setting: Account Settings > Authorized Snyk Apps > Revoke; DELETE /rest/groups/{group_id}/apps/installs/{install_id}; DELETE /rest/self/apps/installs/{install_id}

controls.name: Delete App / replace clientSecret
controls.what: Deleting an app revokes its credentials and all installs; replacing the secret invalidates the old one at once.

controls.name: OAuth2 revoke endpoint
controls.what: Revokes a specific refresh token immediately.

controls.name: Audit logs
controls.what: Group and Org audit log search (90 days) incl. service account and app lifecycle and api.access events.

controls.name: Install Apps (Snyk Apps management permission)
controls.what: Role permission that allows installing Snyk Apps; the pre-defined Org Collaborator role does not have it, and custom roles can leave it off.
controls.setting: Group > Settings > Member roles > Snyk Apps management > Install Apps

controls_unknown: Whether PATs, legacy API tokens or service account tokens bypass SSO / IdP conditional access (not stated).
Any admin setting to disable PATs or legacy API tokens, or to revoke another user's personal token (none documented).
Whether removing a user from a Group/Org or the IdP invalidates their PAT/legacy token (not stated).
Any customer IP allowlist for API requests (none documented).
Audit event names for PAT and legacy token create/revoke (not in the documented event lists).
Contents of api.access events (which fields identify the token or service account).
Admin approval or allowlist for Snyk App installation.

auth_paths.name: Snyk Apps (OAuth 2.0 apps: user or tenant context)

authentication.summary: OAuth 2.0 apps created in an Org. Interactive installs use authorization code (PKCE) and get access + refresh tokens sent as `Authorization: bearer`; apps can also be installed for unattended client_credentials use.

ip_restriction.boundary: Snyk docs describe no customer-configurable IP allowlist for API callers; IP lists in docs cover Snyk scanners reaching your targets.

lifetime.summary: Access token TTL set per app (1h-24h); refresh token single-use

renewal.expiry_basis: refresh token expiry; rotates on each use
renewal.summary: Refresh token exchanged for new pair; old one invalid.

administration.summary: Scopes are Org-level and capped by the installer's permissions. user-context apps lose access when the installer is deactivated; tenant-context installs persist with the Org. Users revoke in Authorized Snyk Apps; admins revoke installs via API; deleting the app revokes all installs. No documented admin approval or allowlist for app installs.

offboard.details: User-context apps lose access when the installing user deactivates their account; tenant-context apps are not tied to the user.

inventory.details: Admins can list apps the Organization created (GET /rest/orgs/{orgId}/apps/creations); the Authorized Snyk Apps page shows only the viewing user's authorizations.

expiry.api: Set access_token_ttl_seconds (3600-86400) in POST https://api.snyk.io/rest/orgs/{org_id}/apps/creations or PATCH /rest/orgs/{org_id}/apps/creations/{app_id}

offboard.ui: Group > Members > Delete member (user-context apps lose access when the installing user deactivates); tenant-context: Authorized Snyk Apps page > Revoke

log_sources.name: Snyk audit logs (Group/Org search API)
log_sources.notes: Enterprise; past 90 days; GET /rest/groups/{group_id}/audit_logs/search and /rest/orgs/{org_id}/audit_logs/search; api.access hidden unless requested via events=api.access.

log_sources.name: Event forwarding (Amazon EventBridge, AWS CloudTrail Lake)
log_sources.notes: Platform audit events, Enterprise; use for retention beyond 90 days.

lifecycle_events.notes: Exists in Group and Org event lists; excluded by default; described as high-volume low-information.

anomaly_cues: App installed by a user who later left (tenant context persists)

containment.steps: Revoke the install (UI or DELETE /rest/groups/{group_id}/apps/installs/{install_id}), revoke refresh token via POST /oauth2/revoke, or delete the app.
containment.notes: Refresh token revoked immediately; whether issued access tokens die before TTL is not stated.

calls.log_notes: Enterprise; api.access hidden by default; per-call detail not documented.
Reads have no explicit action event.

calls.reveals: All vulnerability findings for the Org
calls.log_notes: Reads have no explicit action event.

unknown: Whether GET /rest/orgs works for app tokens
